description: This file defines a React component named PasswordWizard which manages the user interface for changing a password, including steps for input, validation, and confirmation, integrated within a modal dialog.

classes.name: PasswordWizard
classes.description: A React component for a password change wizard with multiple steps, validation, and a modal interface.

methods.name: nextStep
methods.description: Handles progression from the password input step to validation and finalization, managing UI state accordingly.

methods.name: validateCurrentPassword
methods.description: Validates that the current password input is correct and matches confirmation, ensuring the process can proceed.

methods.name: processPasswordChange
methods.description: Performs the password change operation, including backup download, encryption, and server update.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Closes the modal unless there are ongoing processes preventing closure.

methods.name: setFormDataState
methods.description: Updates the form data part of the component's state asynchronously.

methods.name: handleCurrentPasswordInputChange
methods.description: Updates state when the current password input changes.

methods.name: handleNewPasswordInputChange
methods.description: Updates state when the new password input changes.

methods.name: handleNewPasswordConfirmationInputChange
methods.description: Updates state when the password confirmation input changes.
